<subject>GRIDMANAGER/LOAD BALANCE AVAILABILITY</subject>
<body>
To all GRIDMANAGER users:

The GRIDMANAGER platform will be offline nightly from 00:01 to 04:00 CET for 
scheduled grid data updates.  
The system will be accessible again after 04:00, with load forecasts updated 
by 05:30.

LOAD BALANCE will remain operational during this window.

Please contact the GRIDMANAGER Support Line (+49 171 373 5700) for any questions 
or issues.
</body>
